data.name: Rajit
data.gender_notes: Rajit is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Rajit is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘raja’, which means king or ruler. It is also associated with the Sun god, who is considered to be the ultimate ruler of the universe. The name Rajit signifies power, authority, and leadership. The name Rajit carries the meaning “King, Ruler, Sun” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Rajit usually hope their child will grow to embody king, ruler, sun and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Rajit is believed to bring blessings of power, prosperity, and good fortune. It is a name that is deeply rooted in spirituality and is often given to children who are destined to lead and rule.
data.etymology: Rajit belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “King, Ruler, Sun.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rajit total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rajit holds significant cultural value in Hinduism due to its royal connotations. In Hindu mythology and folklore, there are several kings by this name, including King Raji of the Nagas and King Rajit of the Vangas. These rulers were renowned for their courage, wisdom, and generosity. The name Rajit is also given to boys born in royal families or those who show leadership qualities, reinforcing the cultural association with power and rule.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Rajit represents the innate potential for leadership and governance within each individual. According to Hindu beliefs, every person is a manifestation of the divine and holds the power to rule their own lives. The name Rajit serves as a reminder that we all have the capacity to be kings or rulers of our own selves, guiding our thoughts, emotions, and actions with wisdom and compassion. Moreover, Rajit can be seen as a connection to the Sun god and its divine energy, symbolizing strength, vitality, and creative potential.

vedic_reference.note: Rajit is a Vedic name and is mentioned in various Hindu scriptures.

historical_references.reference: Rajit Raja Chola I, also known as Rajaditya Chola I, was a Chola king who ruled from 957 to 985 AD. He is considered to be a great patron of arts and learning, and during his reign, many Tamil literary works were composed.
Rajit Gupta was a king of the Pala Empire in Bengal who ruled from 1179 to 1206 AD. He is known for his military conquests and his patronage of Buddhism and Hinduism.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's interconnected world, the name Rajit continues to be cherished by Hindu families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Hindu name websites where expectant parents research meaningful names. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.
